scope: Existing official npm Codex native processes on one Windows machine

checks.name: Sampled source and installed runtime equality
checks.actual: All three match after CRLF/LF normalization; full package not compared

checks.name: Live source ownership and independent HUD identity
checks.method: verifyHost(hook) with a live process snapshot; PsmuxClient.pane for source and HUD; viewer process incarnation and heartbeat; sessionMetadata/isMainSession for bound transcripts

checks.name: Close and reopen only the proven current HUD
checks.command: stop --launch <verified-current-launch>; wait for exact pane absence; start

limitations: No visual placement, focus or keyboard/mouse/scroll/copy acceptance; user feedback is pending.
Native statusline usability was not visually checked.
Observed direct native-child ancestry does not establish other shared-daemon per-client routing.
Existing bound transcripts were checked; native startup events were not replayed.
Cold-start, formal upgrade and full crash recovery were not exercised.
Counts describe a live snapshot, not a promise that these resources remain available.
